name: Ierissos Town Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy, gentle slope, shallow near shore.
bar_notes: Several cafes/tavernas along the beach road.
notes: The main town beach, faces the open Strymonic/Ierissos Gulf so it takes the full force of easterly winds.

name: Nea Roda Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy and shallow, quieter than Ierissos town beach.
bar_notes: Tavernas and a couple of beach bars near the village.
notes: ~20-25 min from Ierissos. Still on the east (Strymonic Gulf) side, so exposed to the same wind direction as Ierissos.

name: Ouranoupoli Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy town beach, shallow entry, lots of shade options.
bar_notes: Busy promenade with many cafes, bars and restaurants, plus toilets.
notes: ~25-30 min from Ierissos. Faces the Singitic Gulf (west side of the isthmus) - the opposite side from Ierissos, so it's often calm when Ierissos has easterly wind, and vice versa.

name: Trypoti Beach
toddler_notes: Small sandy cove, shallow, generally calm water.
bar_notes: Well-known beach bar right on the sand.
notes: ~20 min from Ierissos. A narrower, more sheltered cove than Ouranoupoli town beach, but popular and can fill up.

name: Kastri Beach
toddler_notes: Sandy, generally shallow, less developed than Trypoti.
bar_notes: No dedicated beach bar on-site; bring your own supplies or drive to nearby Ouranoupoli/Trypoti.
notes: ~20-25 min from Ierissos. Good backup if you don't need a beach bar and want fewer people.

name: Alykes Beach, Ammouliani
toddler_notes: Shallow, calm, turquoise water - very good for small kids.
notes: Requires a short ferry from Tripiti/Ouranoupoli (~10 min crossing) plus driving. Worth it if you want guaranteed calm water.

name: Megali Ammos Beach, Ammouliani
notes: Same ferry trip as Alykes Beach; a bit more open/wider bay.

name: Pyrgadikia Beach
toddler_notes: Small, calm fishing-village beach, shallow water.
bar_notes: A couple of tavernas by the water.
notes: ~30-35 min from Ierissos, further down the Strymonic Gulf coast. Still east-facing like Ierissos.

name: Stratoni Beach
notes: ~35-40 min north of Ierissos. East-facing, same wind exposure as Ierissos.

name: Stavros Beach
bar_notes: Several beach bars and tavernas along the front.
notes: ~50 min north of Ierissos - only worth the drive if you're exploring further afield.

name: Vourvourou (Karidi/Lagoon area)
toddler_notes: Shallow lagoon partly sheltered by Diaporos island - one of the calmest, most toddler-friendly spots in the area.
notes: ~1h10-1h20 drive from Ierissos. Worth it on a genuinely windy day since the lagoon stays calm more often than open beaches.

name: Sarti Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy beach, shallow, but open to the gulf so more affected by wind.
bar_notes: Lots of beach bars and restaurants along the promenade.
notes: ~1h30 drive from Ierissos. Open bay - only calm when wind isn't from the east.

name: Toroni Beach
toddler_notes: Long sandy bay, shallow water, easy for little ones.
bar_notes: Tavernas and beach bars along the bay.
notes: ~1h45 drive from Ierissos. West-facing, so it can be calm when the east coast is choppy.

name: Possidi Beach
toddler_notes: Shallow sandbar/lagoon, one of the best in the region for toddlers.
notes: ~2h drive from Ierissos - only realistic if you're already on Kassandra that day.

name: Sani Beach
toddler_notes: Organized resort beach, shallow and calm, lifeguards.
notes: ~2h drive from Ierissos - only realistic if you're already on Kassandra that day.
